. visitation of those who are housebound . thank you to eucharistic ministers and parishioners for your help in drawing up the list of elderly, housebound and infirmed parishioners who wish to receive the sacraments on or around the first friday of each month. as many of the names were submitted after the first friday, the priest has yet to call, but hopes to do so over the course of the coming week. anyone who would like the priest to call each month is welcome to give their name and address to the parish secretary or the sacristan. church at the crossroads . belfast conference 13–14 november 2026 assembly buildings conference centre. the belfast jesuit centre is delighted to be an official partner for church at the crossroads, a two ‑day conference hosted by palestinian christians for the global church. the gathering invites us to listen and learn from palestinian and international christian leaders as we explore how scripture shapes our response to the realities in the holy land. other speakers include fr timothy bartlett, sean farrell (trocaire) and prof. siobhan garrigan of tcd. for more details and registration, please visit:

belfast dates for your diary november dead list. lists and envelopes are now available. please fill in the names of all the deceased that you would like prayer for, put in the en velope provided and place in the box on the altar. november short-term pledge the month of november offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the sacred heart of jesus. we invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a short-term pledge throughout november. pioneer offering - "i promise, in honour of the sacred heart of jesus, and with the help of the blessed virgin mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of november." please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction. our november mass for the deceased will take place on monday 2nd november at 7pm. this is a mass of remembrance for all our parishioners who have died over the past year, but all are welcome join us to remember their loved ones.
